settings.title: Video Quality
settings.detail: Auto picks from your connection; a fixed choice caps every stream.

settings.title: Quality on Mobile Data
settings.detail: Used instead when you're on mobile data.

settings.title: Trailers
settings.detail: Shows Play Trailer when the server has a trailer.

settings.title: YouTube Fallback
settings.detail: Plays a YouTube trailer when the server has none.

settings.title: Skip Forward
settings.detail: For the skip buttons, double-tap and the arrow keys.

settings.title: Skip Backward
settings.detail: For the skip buttons, double-tap and the arrow keys.

settings.title: Auto-play Next Episode
settings.detail: Starts the next episode when the credits roll.

settings.title: Skip Recap Automatically
settings.detail: Skips a recap when the server knows where it is.

settings.title: Skip Intro Automatically
settings.detail: Skips the intro when the server knows where it is.

settings.title: Skip Credits Automatically
settings.detail: Skips the credits, or moves on to what's next.

settings.title: Skip Ads Automatically
settings.detail: Skips ad breaks in recordings when the server knows where they are.

settings.title: Countdown
settings.detail: How long the button fills before an automatic skip or the next episode.

settings.title: Show Subtitles by Default
settings.detail: Turns on a subtitle track when a video starts.

settings.title: Remember Playback Speed
settings.detail: New videos start at the speed you last picked.

settings.title: When Resuming
settings.detail: What Play does for a title you've started.

settings.title: Mark as Watched
settings.detail: When closing the player counts a title as watched.

settings.title: Preferred Audio Language
settings.detail: Starts on this language when a title has it.

settings.title: Preferred Subtitle Language
settings.detail: Starts on this language when a title has it.

settings.title: Subtitle Timing: Later
settings.detail: How far Subtitle Timing can move picture subtitles later.

settings.title: Subtitle Timing: Earlier
settings.detail: How far it can move them earlier.

settings.title: Chapter List
settings.detail: A button in the player to jump between chapters, when the title has them.

settings.title: SyncPlay
settings.detail: Create or join a group that keeps playback in sync with others.

settings.title: Chromecast
settings.detail: Shows the Cast button when a Chromecast is on your network.

settings.title: Picture in Picture When Leaving
settings.detail: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you go Home.

settings.title: Open Videos In
settings.detail: The rotate button in the player still turns it either way.

settings.title: Double-Tap to Skip
settings.detail: Double-tap a side of the video to skip back or forward.

settings.title: Direct Play HEVC (H.265)
settings.detail: Turn off if HEVC videos stall or stay black on this device; they'll be converted to H.264 instead.

settings.title: Convert to AV1
settings.detail: Only shown where the device decodes AV1 in hardware.

settings.title: Direct Play Surround Audio (AC3/EAC3/DTS)
settings.detail: Only for audio always going to a receiver over AirPlay or HDMI.

settings.title: Compatibility Mode
settings.detail: For videos that won't play at all. The server converts anything that isn't H.264 and AAC.

settings.title: Wait for Wi-Fi
settings.detail: On, downloads wait for Wi-Fi. The app shows it the other way round, as Download on Mobile Data.

settings.title: Downloads at Once
settings.detail: How many download at the same time.

settings.title: Remove Watched When Low on Space
Top Shelf Trailers
settings.detail: Plays a title's trailer in the Top Shelf when you rest on it there, if the server has one. Apple TV decides when it has sound.

settings.title: New Content
settings.detail: Read by older app versions; New Episodes and New Films replace it.

settings.title: Announcements
settings.detail: Messages from the server's admin, and planned maintenance. Needs Arcfin Sync 0.7.

settings.title: Show Active Streams on App Icon
Quiet Hours From
settings.detail: Minutes after midnight.

settings.title: Quiet Hours To
settings.detail: Minutes after midnight.

settings.title: Default Speed
settings.detail: The speed new videos start at.

settings.title: Dialogue Boost
settings.detail: Set from the player's audio menu.

settings.title: Hidden Libraries
settings.detail: Library ids hidden from Browse, comma-separated.

settings.title: Home Shelf Order
settings.detail: Home's rows in order, comma-separated; empty is the default order.

settings.title: Home Shelves Shown
settings.detail: The rows Home shows, comma-separated; empty is the default set.

settings.title: Country
settings.detail: For streaming services; empty uses Seerr's or this device's region.

settings.title: Streaming Services
settings.detail: The streaming service rows on Home, as a JSON list.

settings.title: Tab Order
settings.detail: Tabs in order, comma-separated; empty is the default order.

settings.title: Tabs Shown
settings.detail: The tabs shown, comma-separated; empty is the default set.

settings.title: Music Library Rows
settings.detail: The music library's rows in order, comma-separated.

settings.title: Hidden Music Library Rows
settings.detail: Music library rows hidden, comma-separated.

settings.title: Use Face ID or Touch ID
settings.detail: A faster unlock for a profile with a PIN.
